channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Iowa Lawmakers Consider Raising Tax Incentive Cap for Steel Plant
item.description: Iowa lawmakers are scheduled to convene to vote on increasing the cap for state tax incentives. This proposed increase is reportedly necessary to secure a $15 billion steel plant project in the state. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Colleges Paid Athletes Over $1.77 Billion in Revenue Sharing
item.description: In the first year of Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) payouts, colleges distributed over $1.77 billion to athletes through revenue sharing. According to reports, 68 schools reached or neared the $20.5 million revenue-sharing limit. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Russia Builds Shadow Fleet to Evade Sanctions, EU Expands Naval Mission
item.description: Russia is reportedly building a "shadow fleet" of oil tankers to circumvent international sanctions. In response, the European Union is expanding its naval mission in the Mediterranean to target these vessels. The Daily Telegraph reported… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Walgreens Nears Sale of Boots Pharmacy Chain for Nearly £7 Billion
item.description: Walgreens is nearing a deal to sell its British pharmacy chain, Boots, for approximately £7 billion. The billionaire Issa family, which owns the Primark brand, is reportedly the leading contender to acquire the company. The sale marks a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Japan Business Sentiment Rises for Sixth Consecutive Month
item.description: A survey conducted by Japan's central bank indicates that business sentiment has improved for the sixth month in a row. The survey results show an upward trend in the outlook of businesses. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ted Baker Reopens UK Stores After Administration
item.description: Ted Baker is reopening a standalone store in the United Kingdom, following its collapse into administration and the closure of all 46 of its previous branches in 2024. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 5.

item.description: Indian banks have incurred foreign exchange trading losses amounting to approximately $500 million following changes to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) position caps. The losses occurred after the RBI implemented new regulations affecting… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Avenue Supermarts, operator of DMart stores, is expanding its presence in smaller towns, indicating a shift in consumer demand towards value retail. This move suggests that smaller cities and towns are becoming a significant growth area… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Nuvama has projected that the media and entertainment sector will experience improved growth in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027. This projection is attributed to anticipated festive spending, with a late Diwali expected to boost… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Agra Airport Enhances Flight Connectivity to Bengaluru and Mumbai
item.description: Agra Airport has introduced daily flight services to Bengaluru and a revised schedule for flights to Navi Mumbai. Previously, flights to Bengaluru were not daily, and services to Mumbai were less frequent. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Brent crude oil prices surpassed $102 per barrel, driven by geopolitical tensions including those in the Hormuz Strait and US-Iran conflict. Amidst this surge, Kotak has raised its crude oil forecast for FY27 to $90 per barrel, while also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Indian stock market, including the NSE and BSE, was closed on October 2nd for Gandhi Jayanti. Following this holiday, the market was also closed for the weekend on October 3rd and 4th. Trading resumed on October 5th. The market had… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Apple Pay has launched in India, enabling merchants using Razorpay to accept payments online and in-store without requiring card entry or OTPs. The service is available for eligible Axis Bank Visa and Mastercard credit cardholders… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: India's upcoming CAFE-III norms are set to influence consumer choices for petrol, hybrid, and electric vehicles by 2027. Auto industry veterans have stated that these norms will create pathways for the industry to offer a variety of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Middle East Crude Oil Exports Reach Prewar Levels, Shipments Constrained
item.description: Middle East crude oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to prewar levels, according to analysts. Despite this increase in crude oil shipments, overall fuel shipments from the region remain constrained. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Millions of households in Great Britain are facing an increase in their annual energy bills, with a typical home's cost rising by 4% to an average of £1,723 per year starting Thursday. Forecasts indicate a further potential increase of 16%… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Global bonds are experiencing their worst month in years, coinciding with a rise in US Treasury yields. This pressure on bond markets is also impacting Dalal Street, with factors such as crude oil prices, yields, and heavy supply… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Samsung has launched two new budget smartphones in India, featuring 6,000mAh batteries, 50MP cameras, and security updates until 2032. Additionally, the company has introduced powerful tablets in India, boasting 11,600mAh batteries and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Shares of Indian auto companies declined in September after reaching record highs in August. Hyundai reported record sales for September, selling 77,916 units, a significant increase from previous periods. Other auto companies also saw… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: OpenAI fires three researchers for mishandling sensitive information
item.description: OpenAI announced on Thursday that it has terminated the employment of three researchers. The company stated that the researchers were fired for allegedly mishandling "sensitive information" and violating company policies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices See Significant Fluctuations
item.description: Gold prices are nearing ₹1.39 lakh, while silver has seen a substantial drop of ₹6,000. These price movements are being reported across various cities, including Indore and Raipur, with consumers advised to check local rates. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Greggs to close factories, cut 740 jobs
item.description: Bakery chain Greggs has announced plans to close four of its factories, resulting in the loss of 740 jobs. Separately, nearly 400 workers are facing job losses due to a proposed closure at Grangemouth. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Gautam Adani has reclaimed the position of India's wealthiest individual with a net worth of $112.7 billion, surpassing Mukesh Ambani, who is now second with $86.3 billion. Adani's wealth increased by $20.7 billion, attributed to his… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal was scheduled to meet with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss the early conclusion of an interim trade agreement between the two countries. The talks come amid a US threat of 100%… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.description: Indian stock markets continued their downward trend for a fourth consecutive day, with the Sensex dropping significantly. One report indicated a fall of 570 points due to relentless foreign fund outflows. Another report stated the Sensex… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Anup Bagchi has been appointed as the new Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of HDFC Bank, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan who will step down on October 26. Bagchi, a veteran of the banking sector with extensive experience at the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: US Treasury Yields Hit 24-Year Highs, Stocks Show Resilience
item.description: US 10-year Treasury yields surged to their highest level since 2002, reaching 24-year highs, while US stocks showed resilience and inched up. Despite the surge in yields, stock markets have held up. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Billionaire Peter Thiel is the undisclosed buyer of Casa Encantada, a mega-mansion in Bel-Air, for $130 million. The property has a history of being troubled. The Wall Street Journal reported that Thiel was behind the purchase, while the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Alberta Extends Deadline for $100 Energy Rebate Application
item.description: Alberta has extended the deadline for residents to apply for a $100 energy rebate. The original deadline was not specified, but the extension means more time is now available for eligible individuals to submit their applications for the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ANZ Bank Changes Auditor After 57 Years
item.description: ANZ Bank has changed its auditor, ending a 57-year relationship with KPMG. The specific reasons for the change were not detailed in the coverage provided. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Voice Firm ElevenLabs Valuation Doubles to $22 Billion
item.description: AI voice technology company ElevenLabs has seen its valuation double to $22 billion, driven by a surge in demand for its AI voice-agent services. The company's valuation increase reflects significant growth in the artificial intelligence… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Volantis Secures $88 Million for AI-Memory Chip Interconnection Technology
item.description: Volantis has successfully raised $88 million to develop technology aimed at connecting artificial intelligence (AI) and memory chips. The funding will support the company's efforts in advancing this specialized area of technology. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The U.S. private sector added 90,000 jobs in September, according to ADP, a figure that exceeded expectations. The report indicated job growth in manufacturing and construction sectors, with trade associations noting a significant number… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Alhaji Aliko Dangote, described as Africa's richest man, has launched an oil refinery in Kenya. The refinery is part of a larger plan to industrialize Africa by 2030. The project involves a $300 million deal with US firm Honeywell and has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: The US dollar has reached a 17-month high, with projections indicating a potential three-week gaining streak. This surge is attributed to a global bond sell-off and concerns over France's fiscal stability, which have weakened the euro… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Mark Carney is aiming for final approval of a new Canadian oil pipeline by 2027, a move that faces potential legal challenges from First Nations groups. British Columbia Premier David Eby stated that his government has an important role to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
